title: Refurbished Dryer-Rotary Hot Air Stainless Steel 316 - IPP# 111037
card_title: Refurbished Dryer-Rotary Hot Air Stainless Steel 316
additional_info: Refurbished direct fired This dryer has (6) sets of 12 flights in the drying chamber each 4" wide x 2" thick x 12" long, with product discharge fingers designed to maximize drying. This dryer has external knockers designed to keep the product flowing freely in the feed end. This dryer features a hot air heating system designed to be heated by steam. The steam chest is rated for 256000 BTU/Hr., and has been hydro tested to insure no leakage occurs in the coils. This rotary dryer driven is chain driven by a manually variable speed drive and features a 2.0 HP 3/60/230/460V 1750 rpm motor through an overhauled gear reducer. Other recent work performed is a new seal on the discharge end, Inlet seal has been cleaned, lapped and fitted, all new lubrication lines to the tires,(auto lubricators) and the knockers have been tested and lubricated. Dryer has a 5.75" diameter discharge. Hot air Inlet opening is 16.5" long x 9" wide
